description: Business object for the process metadata status card with routing info, dates, and AI risk score

properties.name: routeType
properties.description: Routing type label shown at the top, e.g. 'Sequential Approval'

properties.name: estimatedCompletion
properties.description: Estimated completion date/time string (formatted for display)

properties.name: aiMaxScore
properties.description: Maximum possible AI score for the gauge (e.g. 100)

properties.name: aiSuggestionLabel
properties.description: Short label describing the AI suggestion action

properties.name: aiSuggestionAction
properties.description: Action key emitted when the AI suggestion link is clicked
